description: This Java class provides utility methods for creating various types of executor services, including work-stealing pools, limited task executors, and scheduled executors, with custom thread factories and configurations.

classes.name: ThingsBoardExecutors
classes.description: Utility class for creating different types of executor services with custom configurations.

methods.name: newWorkStealingPool
methods.description: Creates a ForkJoinPool with a specified parallelism level and thread name prefix.

methods.name: newWorkStealingPool
methods.description: Creates a ForkJoinPool with a specified parallelism level and class-based thread name.

methods.name: newLimitedTasksExecutor
methods.description: Creates a ThreadPoolExecutor with a limited task queue size and custom thread factory.

methods.name: newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor
methods.description: Creates a single-thread scheduled executor with a custom thread name.

methods.name: newScheduledThreadPool
methods.description: Creates a scheduled thread pool with specified core pool size and thread name.
